    intro x hx

  rw [Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset hs, ← sum_eq_card_nsmul key, eventually_atTop]
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hs.bddAbove
  refine ⟨m + 1, fun n n_m ↦ (sum_subset ?_ ?_).symm⟩ <;> intro x <;> rw [hs.mem_toFinset]
